display_information.name: Moji Locker
display_information.description: Make custom emoji for your workspace with /moji.
display_information.long_description: Type /moji [prompt] to describe an emoji. Moji Locker draws it, sizes it to Slack's 128 x 128 limits, and replies privately with a download ready to add from the emoji picker. Start with a style word to change the look: /moji pixel a happy ghost. For motion, text and uploads, visit moji.locker.

slash_commands.description: Make a custom emoji from a description
